patch_description: This design retains the parameter-efficient global RY/RX controls and multiscale butterfly connectivity that performed well previously, but changes when information is mixed. Even-indexed qubits receive the shared RY rotation first, followed by nearest-neighbor CZ gates that couple them to still-unmixed odd qubits. The odd-indexed rotations are then applied, creating a staggered symmetry breaking without adding parameters. Distance-2 and distance-4 CZ layers subsequently propagate these heterogeneous local responses globally, while the final shared RX layer exposes phase correlations to later repetitions and readout. The ansatz preserves two distinct trainable parameters while aiming for better worst-group separation and gradient flow.
